name: hess
expr: [Pa, Ha] = hess(A); err_a = max(max(abs(Pa*Ha*Pa' - A))); orth_a = max(max(abs(Pa'*Pa - eye(3)))); subdiag_a = abs(Ha(3,1)); [Pb, Hb] = hess(B); err_b = max(max(abs(Pb*Hb*Pb' - B))); subdiag_b = max([abs(Hb(3,1)), abs(Hb(4,1)), abs(Hb(4,2))]);
comment: Sig: [P, H] = hess(A). Hessenberg reduction via Householder reflectors; A = P*H*P', H upper-Hessenberg (zeros below sub-diagonal). Foundation for general eig (Phase 2c). Bit-identical reconstruction with MATLAB R2025b; H entries differ in sign/order due to Householder reflector freedom but identity verified to ulp.
